QF.id: AIFM CII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_11

question.text: The Investment Manager of Vindhya Infra AIF (Cat I) appoints a Compliance Officer as required. Within what timeframe MUST the Compliance Officer independently report any deviation directly to SEBI?

answer.text: In the next quarterly filing (up to T+10 from quarter-end).

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Regulation 20(9) of the SEBI (AIF) Regulations (as introduced via the Second Amendment 2021) requires the Compliance Officer, appointed by the Investment Manager, to independently report any deviation to SEBI forthwith within 7 working days. **The Trap:** 24 hours is broker-level breach reporting, not AIF. 30 days is the CTR (Cat III) submission window. Quarterly filing is for general activity, not deviations. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C identical. III-A/C (Compliance) drills timeline-based deviation reporting across SEBI-regulated entities. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Hard-wire a 5-working-day internal escalation SLA so the CO has a 2-day buffer before the 7-day SEBI wall. A missed CO report is a material finding in every SEBI AIF inspection.
